Remark
[Positivity without a uniform lower bound] 1. ch9:3.4The hypothesis $K\ge \delta >0$ cannot be relaxed to $K>0$. Indeed, the paraboloid $\{ (x,y,z)\in \mathbf{R}^3;z=x^2+y^2\} $ has curvature $K>0$, but is complete and non-compact.
